chapter: Learning the trombone and jam sessions
title: Eddie Durham finds Charlie Christian in Oklahoma City
summary: With Lunceford, the band heard a guitarist in a club; Eddie Durham went to cut him and found Charlie Christian.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Where was it that you used to all get together. Was it anytime you ran into each other on the road or --

Anywhere. On the road. I remember one day we were in Oklahoma City, and we were playing Oklahoma City. So, we were in a little club. I was with Lunceford and we heard this guitar player. Man, he was playing so much. So, Eddie Durham was with Lunceford's band.

So, the guys went and told Eddie Durham. Say, Eddie, there's guitar player around here, but anyway he don't play so good, you know. Eddie Durham was playing (unintelligible) trombone and guitar. It's the kind of tricks guys used to play. So, he went around to this little club, and it was Charlie Christian.
